narration.text: Why explosions in space make no sound.
Sound needs matter, and space has almost none.
In air at 0 °C, sound moves about 331 metres per second.
In water, it's about 1,438 metres per second.
In diamond, up to 12,000 metres per second.
So space isn't loud. It's the quietest place there is.
